title: He Fought A War That Had Ended 29 Years Earlier

scenes.say: This soldier kept fighting for twenty-nine years after his war ended.
In 1944, Lieutenant Hiroo Onoda was sent to an island in the Philippines.
scenes.heading: LIEUTENANT HIROO ONODA

scenes.say: When the war ended, leaflets told him it was over. He decided they were fake.
So he stayed in the jungle. Year after year. And his raids cost local villagers their lives.
scenes.label: his raids cost villagers their lives

scenes.say: Then in 1974, a young Japanese traveler went looking for him, and found him in just four days.
But he still refused to surrender, unless his old commander ordered it. That commander was now a bookseller.
scenes.heading: ONE CONDITION

scenes.say: He was flown to the island, and read him the order in person. Only then did Onoda surrender.
scenes.heading: MARCH 9, 1974
